<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex44042023-02-2308-08-03" type="excerpt" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="20. tshad 'bras (15b2–15b7)"/>
            dang po grub mtha' dang sbyar ba ni ¦<quote source="db:5564"><rs type="school">bye brag tu smra ba</rs> ni ¦ <abbr>gzugs sogs</abbr> thug phrad du snang pa'i don dngos <abbr>bzhugs</abbr>¦ phyi don mthong pa tshad ma ¦ phyi don <abbr>rtogs</abbr> pa <abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> pa <abbr>'bras bur</abbr> smra bas ¦ <abbr>gzhal bya</abbr> dang tshad 'bras <lb n="15b3"/> rdzas tha dad dus <abbr>mnyam par</abbr> 'dod ¦
            <rs type="school">mdo sde pa</rs>s ¦ don lkog na mo <abbr>gzhal bya</abbr> ¦ don dang 'dra bar skyes <abbr>pa'i</abbr> shes pa tshad ma ¦ don <abbr>rtogs</abbr> <abbr>btags</abbr> pa <abbr>'bras bur</abbr> smra bas <abbr>gzhal bya</abbr> dang tshad 'bras rdzas tha dad dus <choice><sic>mnyaM par</sic><corr>tha dad par</corr> </choice> 'dod do |
            <rs type="school">rnaM bden pa</rs>s ¦ bzung ba'i rnaM pa <abbr>gzhal bya</abbr> ¦ 'dzin pa'i rnaM pa tshad ma ¦ rang rig <abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> pa <abbr>'bras bur</abbr> <lb n="15b4"/> 'dod pas ¦ <abbr>gzhal bya</abbr> dang tshad 'bras bde sdug myong ba ltar dus dang <abbr>ngo bo</abbr> <abbr>gcig</abbr> du 'dod do |
            <rs type="school">rnaM brdzun pa</rs>s bzung <abbr>pa'i</abbr> rnaM pa sgro <abbr>btags</abbr> <abbr>gzhal bya</abbr> ¦ 'dzin pa'i rnaM pa tshad ma ¦ rang rig <abbr>btags</abbr> pa ba <abbr>'bras bur</abbr> 'dod pas ¦ <abbr>gzhal bya</abbr> dang tshad <abbr>'bras skra </abbr>shad snang pa ltar <abbr>gcig</abbr> pa bkag <abbr>pa'i</abbr> tha dad du <abbr>'dod do</abbr></quote> ces <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs gter</rs> <abbr>las gsungs so</abbr> ¦ <note type="editorial">This is not a literal citation.</note></seg></TEI>
